summary: Busy Swann Road north kerb near the corner, homes 10-25 m away.

drivers.seclusion: Hedged lots behind the kerb; nearest home about 10-15 m, others within 25 m.
drivers.access_and_room: Kerb parking on a wide road; a couple of cars already park at this end.
drivers.traffic: Busy through road with steady traffic and a nearby junction.
drivers.convention: Cars park along here; 1/4P limit applies Mon-Fri 6-11am only.

sun_shade: Trees shade from the north and east; open to the afternoon sun.

best_section.where: North kerb at the east end, before the side-street corner
